'''Brindals''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Limb/Legends|feet]]. Young Brindals were capable of wailing and crying, and Brindals identified as belonging to at least one&mdash;female&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|gender]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Tethan" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a small Brindal girl was present in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]]<ref name="Tethan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|attack]] on Cloud City, the girl was among hundreds of people that crowded in a corridor in order to leave the settlement via one of its [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Hey, look out! A Brindal child has fallen over, help her up!|A youngling in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Dyd2_bg.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A Brindal appeared in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''.]]
A Brindal appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], arrives in Cloud City, albeit shortly before it is attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They can then attempt to find a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] mentioned by a [[Raan Calrissian|recent acquaintance]], although the youngling soon runs into a large crowd attempting to escape the attack.<ref name="Tethan" />

At that point, the Tethan notices the Brindal girl stumble and fall. After the youngling's warnings to the crowd about the fallen child are ignored, they try and force their way through the mass of people to save the girl from being trampled. Finally, the Tethan stabs a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] with another person's [[Hair/Legends|hair]] adornment in order to reach the Brindal. When the youngling then screams to explain the situation, the crowd falls silent, with the girl ceasing to cry and the onlookers going on to compliment the Tethan on their courage.<ref name="Tethan" />
